resources.string: Splits this stop into two visits, for places next door to each other.
Save or discard your changes before splitting this visit.
Places next door can be detected as one stop. Choose when you moved on and where you went next.
Saves two visits, one for each place.
Choose a split time at least a minute after arrival and before departure.
Name the place to split the visit.
Choose a different place for the second visit.
